description: Interactive step-based calculation practice tool for Grade 7 Mathematics — Systematic Factor Listing for 225. Centre stage shows four coloured building blocks representing the prime factors: two orange blocks labelled '3' and two green blocks labelled '5'. At each step, blocks are selected and combined with a multiplication animation, producing a new factor that drops into a growing factor list on the right side. A grocery bag analogy panel at the bottom shows 2 packets of dal and 2 packets of rice forming combinations. The factor list sorts itself in ascending order. Final verification grid shows 225 divided by each factor with a checkmark. Purple accent colour (#8b5cf6) for highlights. Indian school context with clean notebook aesthetic. Baloo 2 / Lilita One font family with varied numeric styles. Mobile-responsive, touch-friendly drag interactions. 5-colour palette: purple, orange, green, white background, dark text.
subject: Number Theory — HCF and Factors

instructions_for_student: Watch as we build every factor of 225 from its prime building blocks (3, 3, 5, 5). At each step, we pick a certain number of primes and multiply them. Count along — how many factors does 225 have in total?
